operating_cadence.peacetime: Provide at least a month of planned routine. Wait for major events or monthly review. Research queue refills do not require human panic.
operating_cadence.wartime: Review daily risk in background. Run at highest stable speed (Speed 3-4 recommended for operations). Lower speed during contested landings or critical front collapses.
operating_cadence.pausing_policy: Observations and status checks do NOT pause time. Pause only for genuine branching player choices or bounded multi-step inputs, restoring time state immediately afterward.

standing_plan_schema.research: Ordered eligible tech IDs with ahead-of-time policy and fallback tech
standing_plan_schema.focus: Ordered national focus tree branch sequence with prerequisite tracking
standing_plan_schema.construction: Building type, state/province ID, level count, and priority queue ordering
standing_plan_schema.production: Equipment variant, factory line allocation, minimum floor, deficit priorities
standing_plan_schema.shortages: Stockpile buffer targets, resource imports, conversion rules
standing_plan_schema.military: Explicit army IDs, operational frontline, breakthrough axis, reserves
standing_plan_schema.events: Pre-decided option mappings for known non-branching events; prompt player on critical branching crises

daily_priority_checklist: 1. Chronology and observation freshness check (ensure window attached)
2. Protect survival: collapsing frontline, imminent encirclement, threatened capital/sole port, fuel depletion
3. Execute routine event options; leave critical unknown political dilemmas for player
4. Refill empty research and focus slots; ensure factories are fully assigned
5. Repair equipment deficits and supply bottlenecks before spawning mass unequipped divisions
6. Check army orders and objective progress; trigger review if battle plan is bogged down
